Porsche 911 Targa 2.7 – 1975 | Enthusiast Project
A 1975 Porsche 911 Targa with a 2.7-litre air-cooled flat-six engine and 915 manual gearbox. Imported from California in 2020, this is a left-hand-drive example.
The car is a restoration project and will require further investment. The body remains largely original but shows scratches, minor rust spots and general wear. The chrome wheels have some flaking, and the tyres are aged and will need replacing.
The interior features original black leather seats and a period Toshiba stereo. The Targa roof was recovered in 2020.
